create or replace package body billing_api as
  procedure pay(p_bill_id in number, p_amount in number) is
    v_outstanding_balance NUMBER;
  begin
    -- 1. Record the payment
    insert into bill_payments (bill_id, amount) values (p_bill_id, p_amount);

    -- 2. Get the current outstanding balance for the bill
    -- Assuming 'bills' table has a column 'balance_due' representing the outstanding amount.
    select balance_due into v_outstanding_balance
    from bills
    where bill_id = p_bill_id;

    -- 3. Update the bill's balance and status
    -- Decrease the balance due by the payment amount.
    update bills
    set balance_due = balance_due - p_amount,
        status = CASE
                     WHEN (balance_due - p_amount) <= 0 THEN 'PAID'
                     ELSE 'PARTIAL'
                 END
    where bill_id = p_bill_id;

  exception
    when no_data_found then
      -- Handle case where bill_id does not exist
      null;
  end pay;
end billing_api;
